# `deposits.term_deposit.DepositConstituted`

The deposit is opened: principal, the rate-sheet-resolved TAN, and the AT_MATURITY schedule fixed at constitution. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | DepositId (Guid). |
| `principal_cents` | `long` | Principal as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents, [ADR-PC-010](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-010-dotnet-hand-rolled-engine.md) §P1). |
| `tan_basis_points` | `int` | Annual nominal rate (TAN) in basis points, resolved from the rate sheet at constitution. |
| `rate_sheet_version_id` | `string` | The pinned rate-sheet version the TAN was resolved from. |
| `term_days` | `int` | Term length in days. |
| `start_date` | `int` (`date`) | StartDate (DateOnly) as days since epoch. |
| `maturity_date` | `int` (`date`) | MaturityDate (DateOnly) as days since epoch. |
| `interest_variant` | `string` | Interest variant discriminator (e.g. AT_MATURITY). |
| `auto_renewal_policy` | `string` | Auto-renewal policy discriminator. |
| `payment_period_months` | `int` | PERIODIC coupon cadence in months (1 monthly, 3 quarterly); 0 for AT_MATURITY/ADVANCE. Additive with a default so pre-F.1 AT_MATURITY records that never carried it still decode (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md)). |
| `product_code` | `string` | The catalogue product code (e.g. dpz_pt_12m_juros_venc) — the STRUCTURAL product identifier the rate sheet prices (ConstituteDepositCommand.ProductId), the queryable 'which product is this' dimension that rate_sheet_version_id (a price/version key, one-to-many to products) cannot provide. Structural, NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). Additive with a default so pre-v794 records that never carried it still decode as the empty default (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3); those historical deposits are NOT back-fillable from the log because the code is discarded at constitution and rate_sheet_version_id→product is one-to-many. Prospective only (bd babelstone-v794). |
| `role` | `string` | The pricing role the rate sheet priced the TAN against (ConstituteDepositCommand.Role, e.g. 'standard') — a STRUCTURAL pricing dimension, NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). Persisted so the engine can re-resolve the SAME (product, role) rate at auto-renewal entirely from the closing deposit, keeping product-family knowledge out of the orchestrator ([ADR-IC-003](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-003-saga-orchestrator.md) §A7). Additive with a default so pre-mtto.5 records that never carried it still decode as the empty default (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3); a renewal of such a deposit defaults the empty role to 'standard' (the v1 default role). Prospective only (bd babelstone-mtto.5). |
| `funding_account` | `string` | An OPAQUE funding-account TOKEN — a REFERENCE the engine resolves internally, NEVER an IBAN/cleartext account identifier ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2: references are allowed on the durable bus; PII is not). The legacy current account the principal was debited / the renewal rollover is debited (ConstituteDepositCommand.FundingAccount). Persisted so the engine can settle the auto-renewal rollover debit against the SAME funding reference entirely from the closing deposit, keeping product/funding knowledge out of the orchestrator ([ADR-IC-003](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-003-saga-orchestrator.md) §A7). Additive with a default so pre-mtto.5 records that never carried it still decode as the empty default (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3); a renewal of such a deposit fails loud rather than debit an empty funding reference. Prospective only (bd babelstone-mtto.5). |
| `min_withdrawal_cents` | `long` | F.12 partial-withdrawal gate PINNED at constitution: the smallest partial withdrawal the product allows, in integer EUR cents (PartialWithdrawalPolicy.MinWithdrawalCents). 0 ⇒ no minimum. Resolved from the product config's partial_withdrawal block and stamped here so the policy a live deposit is subject to is fixed at constitution — a config edit cannot retroactively change it (the per-instance pinning the rate/term get, [ADR-PC-009](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-009-per-instance-version-pinning.md)). Structural config, NOT PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). Additive with a default so pre-F.12 records that never carried it decode as 0 = Unrestricted (forward-only schema evolution, [ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P3). Prospective only (bd babelstone-k6r8.8/qze9). |
| `min_remaining_balance_cents` | `long` | F.12 partial-withdrawal gate PINNED at constitution: the smallest principal that may remain on deposit after a partial withdrawal, in integer EUR cents (PartialWithdrawalPolicy.MinRemainingBalanceCents). 0 ⇒ no floor. Same pinning + additive-default semantics as min_withdrawal_cents. Structural config, NOT PII. Prospective only (bd babelstone-k6r8.8/qze9). |
| `carencia_days` | `int` | F.12 partial-withdrawal gate PINNED at constitution: the lock-up (carência) window in days from constitution during which no partial withdrawal is allowed (PartialWithdrawalPolicy.CarenciaDays). 0 ⇒ no lock-up. A duration in days, not money. Same pinning + additive-default semantics as min_withdrawal_cents. Structural config, NOT PII. Prospective only (bd babelstone-k6r8.8/qze9). |
